messages:
Ava: Quick sync — Crescendo Cloud just greenlit the marketplace listing. Need a final pass on logo lockup, hero screenshot, marketplace copy, and written permission for co-marketing. Can we close this today? cc @Maya @Liam @Sanjay

Liam: Do we have SVGs? Marketplace needs 2x/3x assets and left/right lockups. If Crescendo only sent PNGs we'll ask for vectors.

Maya: I can draft copy. Quick question — CTA: 'Get started' vs 'Request demo'?

Sanjay: Legal needs Crescendo's trademark usage terms + a written permission for listing and co-marketing. Also want to review the quote text before it goes live.

Ava: They dropped a zip earlier: https://files.crescen.do/r/redwood-assets.zip — contains guidelines.pdf and logos (mostly PNGs). Jordan said they'd follow up with SVGs.

Liam: I pulled the zip — no SVGs, one ai file with weird layers. Hero.jpg is 900x500 low-res. I'll request proper exports and white/dark lockup variations.

Tom: Product preference: use our integration demo screenshot (staging) as hero — more consistent with other marketplace tiles. Liam, can you capture at 1440x800, blur any emails, and use staging org 'cres-demo'?

Maya: Draft marketplace blurb: 'Deploy Redwood models on Crescendo Cloud with turnkey provisioning, regional failover, and cost-aware routing. Ideal for latency-sensitive apps.' CTA options: 'Get started' (PLG) or 'Request demo' (enterprise).

Sanjay: That copy looks fine but hold on the partner quote. We need Crescendo's sign-off on the exact wording. Also add a short legal disclaimer: 'Partnership does not imply endorsement.'

Ava: Noted. Jordan — can you confirm you'll send SVGs and a short partner quote (1-2 lines)? Also confirm permission for logo usage on marketplace and co-marketing.

Jordan (Crescendo): Thanks — sending SVGs and a 1-line quote now. Permission for logo use included in the attached email. Expect files in ~30m.

asset-bot: Upload received: /files/crescendo-assets/2026-03-15/ — contains guidelines.pdf, logo.png, logo@2x.png, hero.jpg

Liam: Got the upload. I'll mock the hero using a staging screenshot if SVGs don't arrive EOD. Will produce white/dark lockups and export SVG from PNG as fallback, then tag legal for review.

Maya: Alt text proposals: (A) 'Redwood Inference console connected to Crescendo Cloud', (B) 'Redwood models deployed on Crescendo infrastructure'. Which do we prefer?

Sanjay: Use A. Also require the term sheet excerpt (section 4) be attached to the partner packet for audit.

Tom: Confirm region tag for listing: include 'us-west-2' and 'eu-central-1' if Crescendo confirms. Product OK with copy and 'Get started' CTA.

Maya: Uploaded marketplace copy v1 to our drive: /docs/partners/crescendo/marketplace-copy-v1.md — changed CTA to 'Get started' and included alt text A.

Ava: Plan: 1) Liam to post final hero + lockups, 2) Maya finalize copy and alt text, 3) Sanjay to sign off on legal language once Crescendo permission + quote come in. Target publish Wed 9am PT.

Liam: I'll request SVGs and the white/dark versions. If Crescendo doesn't provide by EOD I'll create a vector fallback and ping legal for expedited review.

Jordan (Crescendo): Sent SVGs and quote via email thread (subject: 'Redwood Marketplace assets') and attached the usage permission PDF.

Sanjay: Received the email and permission PDF. I'll do a quick review and post thumbs-up or any change requests here by EOD.

Ava: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the final upload to the marketplace staging repo and post the deploy checklist when ready. :thumbsup:
